calendar.selection: Every calendar sunrise and sunset; no label-based or score-based selection

primaryObservable.domain: Both fixed +/-10-degree Sun/antisolar azimuth wedges, elevation0.5..85 degrees; source|x|<=150km

primaryComparison: Paired AUC difference: primary observable minus frozen section-optics-0.3.1 at the same common-altitude instant, with native cloud-layer baseline also reported
secondary: Original heuristic maximum over its fixed +/-40-minute curve
Phase g=0,.75,.9 at the same altitude
Covered radiance and per-channel numerical sensitivity
Ordinal Spearman and top20 calendar source-label precision
nativeBaseline: max(native_mid,native_high)*(1-native_low/100) at the observer and common-altitude instant
ancillaryPolicy: Pure ERA5/EAC4 comparison: no precipitation/visibility in these bundles. The frozen heuristic uses its declared neutral defaults for absent optional fields, reported explicitly.
numericalGate: Six fixed coarse/dense media, base/tight/gas/changed-partition controls, all raw/covered RGB channels; same source identity as candidate. Each calendar failure remains missing with its reason and retained diagnostic frame.
missingness: Report counts of calendar events, returned explicit labels, missing labels, numerical failures, and paired complete cases. Keep all records; report label distribution of failures when labels become available.
evidencePolicy: Preserve explicit source grades and linked/source-only provenance. Independently unverified source-only zero labels remain source-label evidence. Link presence has its own evidence strength.
scope: Retrospective reanalysis structural ranking. Accuracy/calibration and operational fixed-run/fixed-lead skill retain their own evidence requirements.
promotionPolicy: Keep production frozen through this experiment. A stronger ranking, numerical reliability and adequate independent observation coverage determine any later promotion decision.
numericalRanking: Use per-event score +/- total numerical error estimates; combine the union of retained control intervals when controls are available. Overlapping intervals retain numerical ties. Preserve failed predictions as missing and report all-label pairwise sensitivity bounds, alongside nominal paired complete-case AUC and coverage.

resourcePolicy.failurePolicy: Preserve wall/ray/source budget failures as null predictions with their reason and retain all calendar identities
